name: C++
description: Modern C++ from classes and RAII through the STL, templates, move semantics and performance work.

nodes.name: C++ basics
nodes.desc: Types, I/O streams, namespaces, std::string and how C++ extends C.

nodes.name: References & pointers
nodes.desc: References, const correctness, pointers and passing by value or reference.

nodes.name: Overloading
nodes.desc: Function overloading, default arguments and inline functions.

nodes.name: Classes
nodes.desc: Classes, access control, constructors, member functions and static members.

nodes.name: RAII & destructors
nodes.desc: Destructors, the rule of three/five and tying resource lifetime to object lifetime.

nodes.name: Operator overloading
nodes.desc: Overloading arithmetic, comparison, stream and subscript operators sensibly.

nodes.name: Inheritance & virtual
nodes.desc: Inheritance, virtual functions, vtables and abstract base classes.

nodes.name: Templates
nodes.desc: Function and class templates, template argument deduction and specialisation.

nodes.name: STL containers
nodes.desc: vector, deque, list, map, unordered_map, set and their complexity guarantees.

nodes.name: Iterators & algorithms
nodes.desc: Iterator categories and the <algorithm> library: sort, find, transform and friends.

nodes.name: Text indexer project
nodes.desc: Build a word index over a set of files with STL containers and fast lookups.

nodes.name: Move semantics
nodes.desc: Rvalue references, move constructors, std::move and perfect forwarding.

nodes.name: Smart pointers
nodes.desc: unique_ptr, shared_ptr and weak_ptr and when to use each.

nodes.name: Lambdas
nodes.desc: Lambda expressions, captures, std::function and functional style with algorithms.

nodes.name: std::thread
nodes.desc: std::thread, mutexes, condition variables, atomics and futures.

nodes.name: Build & CMake
nodes.desc: Compilation units, linking, headers and building projects with CMake.

nodes.name: UB & sanitizers
nodes.desc: Common undefined behaviour and catching it with AddressSanitizer and UBSan.

nodes.name: Profiling
nodes.desc: Measuring performance, cache-friendly data layout and profilers.

nodes.name: Matrix library project
nodes.desc: Write a generic matrix class with operators, move semantics and benchmarks.
